status: Committed release 1.0.0-2 passes all six native OBS builds and both Leap architecture lint checks with zero module/package diagnostics. change: Hard-link identical notices without changing any bytes or paths; build-time full directory comparison and file/inode checks cover payload preservation. Public OBS repack URLs replace bare source names; package description uses incremental parsing. No lint filters or diagnostic exceptions.
